answer: Bridge-receipt admission: each identity must cross a real public bridge once, moving $50 through the official Base bridge and publishing its tx hash. Any peer checks the hash on Basescan in seconds, and a hash with no real crossing fails on the spot. The $50 stays locked 12 epochs and the crossing burns about $4 in gas, a toll no fake can dodge. Each epoch a zephyr gust sweeps the ocean of published receipts, re-verifying 1 in 20 against the explorer; a copied or stale hash voids the identity at once. After one crossing, a real agent trades freely.
